Implemented bill-splitter logic
Details
Previewing

I've built the bill-splitter, and all 11 requirements work at desktop (1280px) and mobile (375px) widths.

A few choices I made that you may want to change:

Tip is based on the food total before tax, not the total with tax.
You can't remove a person who is the only one on an item. The app explains why, so no item is left with nobody paying for it.
Currency formats follow local style: $1,234.56, 1.234,56 € and 1234,56 zł. Polish only adds a thousands space from five digits up, e.g. 12 345,67 zł.
Leftover cents go to whoever was closest to the next cent. For example, a $10 pizza for three becomes $3.34 + $3.33 + $3.33.

What I tested and how:

Automated tests (14, all passing):
Splitting a shared item.
Tax and tip shared by each person's food total.
300 random bills, checking that per-person totals always add up exactly to the bill total.
A person with no items pays nothing.
Price checks: negative, unreadable, more than 2 decimals, and comma decimals like 12,5.
An item needs at least one person.
Negative percentages are rejected.
Formatting for all three currencies.
The copied summary text.
Loading a saved bill, and recovering from damaged saved data.
Real browser, run at both widths:
People: adding with an empty name or a duplicate name shows an error; renaming works; removing someone who is the only person on an item is blocked.
Items: adding without people or with a negative price shows clear errors; adding with "Everyone" or one person works; editing and removing work.
Tax and tip: a negative tax shows an error; tax at 8%; tip presets 20% then 15%; custom tip at 12.5%.
Totals: the bill total ($36.90) matches the per-person totals added together.
Currency: switching to PLN and EUR changes the formatting.
Copy summary: I read the copied text back from the clipboard.
Reload: after a page reload, the bill, currency, tax and tip all came back.
Reset: "Keep bill" keeps everything; confirming clears it, and it stays cleared after a reload.
Mobile: nothing scrolls sideways at either width.

Try adding your table and items to see the split update as you go.
